answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, slashed on a failed audit, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Each submission hangs on the canyon of a task receipt, and the pulse is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. By the horizon of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
